subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: What operator-visible lifecycle should rotated cron quarantine archives have before recovery rotation is introduced?
rationale: The branch intentionally avoids deletion, but retaining every archive indefinitely converts an OOM guard into cumulative disk-exhaustion risk; source review cannot choose the retention and recovery policy on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Doctor-managed cleanup
options.body: Keep recovery archives intact by default, surface their count and size in Doctor, and offer explicit operator-approved cleanup.

options.title: Bounded automatic retention
options.body: Adopt a documented count or age limit and accept automatic removal of older recovery archives.

options.title: Narrow the PR to caps
options.body: Restore the existing failure behavior on overflow and ship only bounded reads and writes until a separate recovery policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Doctor-managed cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep recovery archives intact by default, surface their count and size in Doctor, and offer explicit operator-approved cleanup.
